_readme: Hand-editable source for the tool lists. scripts/build_tools.py joins this with the pages on disk and writes data/tools.json, the generated regions in index.html, tools.html and the district pages. A page with no entry here still appears (title and description from the page), with a warning. To feature a tool, set featured to true: featured tools come first on the district page and fill the cards on the home page. 'added' (YYYY-MM-DD) is the date of the page's first commit and drives the Newest order; python3 scripts/build_tools.py --stamp-dates fills it in from git for pages that have none; an external entry sets it by hand. Blurb convention, for tools and districts alike: one line, no final period, no filler opening, American spelling, 92 characters at most (the generator warns past that). Say what the tool does or shows; spell out jargon or leave it out. 'elsewhere' lists links that are not tools; they only appear in the hub when a search matches them. A district's 'external' list adds pages hosted outside this repo (the Experiments district lists pages from the oaustegard/experiments repo, served at /experiments/): each needs href, title and blurb, and may set featured, kind and source (a directory under the district's sourceBase, linked on its page).
